task: Improve operator recovery diagnostics for verified Lattice CLI flow failures without weakening lifecycle gates.
outcome: A user who hits these failures sees concrete terminal guidance: validate timeout output names the killed timeout and timeoutMs knob; stale evidence says hash binding changed and prints lattice recovery commands; same-worktree owner lease blocks explain the safer takeover path; missing delivery-check explains the compliant reviewer-provenance fallback; lattice codex session_brief points to lattice session_brief instead of unrelated Codex adapter commands.
facts: executeValidationPlan currently marks timedOut but renders only a short timed out suffix.
renderEvidenceStaleHint is shared by session_brief/story_advance/validate hints but still prints koala commands and omits the hash-binding explanation.
Owner lease blocks are enforced centrally; active foreign leases currently point only to read-only/wait/forceTakeover without same-worktree context guidance.
DONE oracle correctly requires delivery-check.json and currently says to run koala-review-delivery plus delivery_check_set.
CLI alias map supports lattice codex verify/doctor; lattice codex session_brief currently fails as unknown command codex and suggests verify_codex/codex_doctor only.
constraints: Do not weaken validation, owner lease, stale evidence, or DONE delivery-check gates.
Do not let the main agent forge koala-review-delivery authority.
Keep behavior host-neutral across Codex, Claude, and local shell invocation.
Only fix real recovery correctness issues; avoid broad command namespace redesign or arbitrary optimization.
Use existing Lattice command and smoke-test patterns.
